items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: We were playing at the Metropole and Roy... I said, 'That's no musicianship... So he switched to another cut 'Body and Soul'. 'Play this; play that.' Buster got mad and went home and I walked off too...

ctx.x: That's a good way to feel.
What was that about Roy Eldridge?
